Explore graduate studies at K-State
Thank you for considering K-State for your graduate education! We have several ways for you to learn about our graduate programs, connect with a graduate representative, attend a webinar or event, and explore our campus. Connect with your graduate recruitment representative through email gradapply@ksu.edu or by phone 785-532-0225.

Find a graduate program
Find your graduate representative
Connect with a graduate representative to answer questions and get you started on your graduate journey at K-State.
Explore campus
Schedule an in-person meeting with a graduate program, sign up for a tour of the Manhattan campus, or tour campus virtually.
Attend webinars and events
Attend a webinar or connect with the Graduate School at an event to learn about the value of a graduate degree, areas of study at K-State, and how to navigate the application process.
Discover your program
When you find a program of interest, we recommend you connect with the program director to learn how the program can support your interest and career goals.
